description: An object with `__enter__` and `__exit__`; `with` calls `__exit__` on every way out of the block.
A block that runs whether the `try` body succeeded, raised, returned or broke out of a loop.
Every exception derives from `BaseException`; application errors derive from `Exception`, so `except Exception` leaves `KeyboardInterrupt` and `SystemExit` alone.
`__context__` links an exception to the one being handled when it was raised; `raise ... from` sets `__cause__` explicitly.
One exception that carries several unrelated ones; `except*` handles its members by type.
